scope: Name step (awaiting_name, agent name action, explicit name labels): conversational replies and dish names must not become the order name

realChatAudit.source: 130 real customer chats of 18/10 (PDF export), replayed turn by turn through the real router with the beta menu fixture, agent off; same-minute bubbles merged like the coalescer, PDF line wraps joined. Personal data is not copied into specs or docs.

findings.conversationalReplyStoredAsName: 15 chats (thanks, acknowledgements, complaints, payment questions, a dish, a removal command)
findings.spuriousUnavailableNotice: 42 chats: greetings/courtesy/fillers in an order line produce «Por ahora no manejamos: …» (some lose the whole order: «Arroz paisa / Buenas noches», «medio pollo frito / Pirfa»)
findings.pendingChoiceLostWhenAddressArrives: 11 chats: address (alone or with the option word) during an open option drops the pending dish
findings.orderNumberLookupLoop: 6 chats: once the bot asks for an order number, later orders, addresses and thanks keep getting the same request
findings.staleUnavailableReplyRepeated: 6 chats: the previous «No tenemos esos productos…» reply is repeated for unrelated messages
findings.noResuelvoForStatusOrEta: 17 chats: «ya salió?», «se demoran?», «ya casi está?» answered «Eso no lo resuelvo por este chat»
findings.priceQuestionAsksWhichProduct: 4 chats: «cuánto es?» with several lines asks which product instead of the total
findings.addressAbsorbsPaymentOrCourtesyWords: about 15 chats: «; Para», «; Te», «Ok com datáfono…», option word or «Si por favor»/«Listo muchas gracias» inside the address
findings.comboHandling: about 10 chats: «combo de arroz chino» picks one combo silently, «en combo» after a dish is lost, the combo drink becomes a separate soda, «combo mixto» not found, «sin combo» ignored
findings.quantityFromDrinkName: 1 chat: «gaseosa 7 up» set quantity 7 on the dish

baselineFindings: awaiting_name: «Ok gracia», «Dale, muchas gracias», «Listo, muchas gracias», «Ah dale gracia», «Vale te encargo», «Nada que llega», «Ok ya reci», «Pregunta le pago al mensajero…», «Y me puedes enviar salsas», «Por favor bien caliente y con salsas», «Te recomiendo por fa» were stored as the customer name and the order moved to payment
«A nombre de» alone stored the name «de»
A dish of the menu typed at the name question («jugo de lulo») became the customer name
fix: isUsableWhatsappCustomerName rejects text containing words a personal name never carries (courtesy, acknowledgements, clitic pronouns, checkout verbs such as pago/encargo/quedo/llega/quita, fillers and connectors such as con/sin/por/para/que, «nombre», misspelled «gracias») and text made only of connectors (de/del/la/los/el/y). Articles inside names («María de los Ángeles», «José del Carmen») and the name «Gracia» stay valid. The awaiting_name branch also rejects a reply whose words all belong to one catalog product including its head noun. The same predicate guards the agent name action, explicit name labels, compound parsing and linked/profile names.

asks: 16 conversational replies at the name question
catalog dish name at the name question

knownGaps: «A nombre de» alone now re-asks the name; it does not prompt for the rest of the phrase
The other real-chat findings above remain for the next batches
